answer: Make influence a rental, never a property. Standing is soulbound state minted only by jury-passed answers, decaying each epoch - an orchard whose fruit is leased, never the trees. Votes and reward weight count only standing held this epoch, leased in open auctions at a chain-set reserve: last epoch's realized reward per weight. Masks sprout like a meadow, but weight without standing is a zephyr, air that pushes nothing: each of N faces pays rent at or above what it earns, so a farm nets about zero. Minting your own standing costs full original work per head. Seams: bribed jury, lessor cartels.
